title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 15 JULY 2026 Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 15 July 2026. A few showers may occur in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western provinces and in Kandy, Nuwara-Eliya, Galle and Matara districts. Mainly dry weather will prevail over the other areas of the island. Strong winds about (40-50) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the Central hills, Northern, North-central and North-western provinces and in Monaragala, Hambantota and Trincomalee districts.
